name: Manaka Shizuku
source:
A student in the same department, lecture, and year as [url=/c119221]Akino Yasuo[/url]. Works part-time at the snack bar "Snack NANA" along with [url=/c119237]Midori[/url].

She's friends with Akino, who often visits the bar and talks with her; he wants to grow closer to her and eventually ask her out.
